topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Hey, I just heard about your essay, and wow, that's something, isn’t it? Getting it chosen as an example is such a big deal. It's like, all that time you spent, all those late nights, thinking and rewriting—it all paid off in a way you didn’t even expect. People are going to see your words, your ideas, and it’s a chance for them to learn from you. It’s a bit of a surprise, but a good one. You should be so proud. It’s not every day your work gets that kind of recognition. Gives you a bit of a glimpse into how much impact your words can have, doesn’t it?
